headline.purpose: Meeting Prep page and brief titles.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Generation and direct PDF export actions.
components.css: .ds-primary {font-family: var(--font, 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:38px; padding:8px 13px; border:1px solid var(--border, #e2e5ea); border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px); font-size:12px; font-weight:500; line-height:1.4; cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent, #3563e9); border-color:var(--accent, #3563e9); color:white;} .ds-primary:hover {background:#2c52c5;} .ds-primary:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3563e9); outline-offset: 3px;} .ds-primary:disabled {opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary {font-family: var(--font, 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:38px; padding:8px 13px; border:1px solid var(--border, #e2e5ea); border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px); font-size:12px; font-weight:500; line-height:1.4; cursor:pointer;background:var(--surface, #fff);color:var(--text-2, #3d4556);} .ds-secondary:hover {background:var(--surface-hover, #f0f2f5);} .ds-secondary:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3563e9); outline-offset: 3px;} .ds-secondary:disabled {opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;}

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: Visible label above a compact bordered field.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Meeting focus<input class="ds-field" value="Quarterly portfolio and goals review"></label>
components.css: .ds-label {font-family: var(--font, 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;color:var(--text-2, #3d4556);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;} .ds-field {font-family: var(--font, 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);min-width:0;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border, #e2e5ea);border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px);background:var(--surface, #fff);color:var(--text, #1a1f2e);font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;font-weight:400;} .ds-field:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3563e9); outline-offset: 3px;}

components.name: Active navigation
components.description: Selected item in the incumbent sidebar; SVG is an illustrative inline icon.
components.html: <button class="ds-nav"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M4 4h16v16H4zM8 8h8M8 12h8M8 16h5"/></svg>Meeting Prep</button>
components.css: .ds-nav {font-family: var(--font, 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;width:100%;padding:8px 12px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent-soft, rgba(53,99,233,.08));color:var(--accent, #3563e9);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;line-height:1;text-align:left;letter-spacing:-.008em;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s ease;} .ds-nav:hover {background:var(--accent-soft, rgba(53,99,233,.08));} .ds-nav:focus-visible {outline:auto;}

components.name: Accent chip
components.description: Compact metadata chip; static, with no interactive state.

components.name: Bordered card
components.description: Flat card with divided header and content.
components.html:
Evidence
Select a reference in the brief to inspect its original record.
components.css: .ds-card {font-family: var(--font, 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);background:var(--surface, #fff);border:1px solid var(--border-subtle, #ebedf1);border-radius:var(--radius, 10px);overflow:hidden;color:var(--text, #1a1f2e);} .ds-head {padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle, #ebedf1);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;} .ds-body {padding:14px 16px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--text-3, #6b7280);}

components.name: Source reference
components.description: Inline evidence reference, with stronger selected/hover fill.
components.css: .ds-ref {font-family: var(--font, 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);padding:2px 4px;color:var(--accent, #3563e9);border:0;border-radius:3px;background:var(--accent-soft, rgba(53,99,233,.08));font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;} .ds-ref:hover,.ds-ref[aria-pressed=true] {background:var(--accent-medium, rgba(53,99,233,.15));} .ds-ref:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3563e9); outline-offset: 3px;}

narrative.overview: The existing advisor dashboard is a compact working interface: DM Sans, white cards on a cool gray canvas, fine borders and blue actions. Meeting Prep extends this vocabulary inside the current sidebar and topbar. Its brief reads as a structured document, with evidence kept alongside the text.
keyCharacteristics: White surfaces separated by subtle borders.
Blue actions, navigation selection and source references.
Visible draft, review and synthetic-data states.

rules.name: The Blue Action Rule
rules.body: Use blue for actionable emphasis and selection; reserve semantic colors for status and categorization.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy through weight, spacing and a restrained size ramp; keep the brief in the existing DM Sans family.

rules.name: The Bordered Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate resting surfaces with neutral fills and fine borders; reserve the incumbent hover shadow for interactive client cards.

dos: Do preserve the current sidebar, topbar, DM Sans family and compact dashboard density.
Do keep source references next to the claims they support and show the selected original record in the evidence area.
Do keep draft/review text, advisor-edit attribution, synthetic-data labels and export state visible.
Do let action groups wrap and stack the brief and evidence on narrower screens.
donts: Don't introduce a new display face, decorative hero treatment or replacement visual concept for this extension.
Don't apply client-card hover elevation to every resting card.
Don't indicate review status or errors through color alone.
